The 10.6-inch OZMO Roller 3.0 scrubs up to 200 times per minute and rinses itself with fresh water in real time, helping remove sticky messes without repeatedly spreading dirty water. TruEdge 3.0 extends the air-cushioned roller closer to walls and furniture, while Triple Lift automatically raises the roller over carpets, lifts both brushes for liquid spills and adjusts the side brush around larger debris. AIVI 3D 4.0 uses AI-powered vision and structured light for more precise obstacle recognition, while the TruePass system helps the robot cross common household thresholds. PowerBoost restores approximately 10% battery power during a three-minute roller-washing stop to support extended cleaning. After each task, the OMNI Station washes the roller with fresh water heated up to 167°F, removes wastewater with dual scrapers, dries the roller, empties dust, dispenses cleaning solution and cleans its internal dirty-water system!
